source_name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Medicare Part D Spending by Drug. Manufacturer field Overall, sorted by total claims in 2024.
licence: The dataset page calls this a Public Use File (Free). USAGov, updated April 30, 2026, says a U.S. government work is a work made by an officer or employee as part of official duties, that not every file on a federal site is one, and that use must not imply endorsement.
what_is_counted: Medicare Part D prescription claims for 2024. Self-administered drugs. Over-the-counter claims are excluded. One row per drug where the manufacturer field is Overall. Not all-payer prescriptions. No strength, dosage form, or controlled-substance schedule is in this extract. A row label is kept only when it is not the generic name with a footnote mark.
